description: Milestone grants on the Nidhi repo itself. The DAO approver pre-signs a mandate for each milestone spec (scripts: node src/milestone.ts commit <id>). A developer opens a PR whose title contains the milestone tag, e.g. "[m1] ...". When it is merged and passes the rubric, the agent (node src/agent.ts, or the agent GitHub Action) signs its attestation and sends the payout itself.

m1.title: Document the milestone agent
m1.note: Demo milestone: no approving review required, so one person can run the whole demo.

m2.title: Improve the Milestones screen
m2.note: Standard rules: merged, one approving review, CI green. Paid to bob.nidhi-dao.eth on Arbitrum Sepolia.
